What We Offer

Your one-stop
marine partner.

From engine repairs to full yacht management, Marine Pointe has every service your vessel needs — all under one roof in Fort Lauderdale.

Maintenance & Repairs

Certified technicians handle everything from routine maintenance and engine overhauls to gel coat repairs and electrical systems. Your vessel, always shipshape.

Learn more

Yacht Management

Our comprehensive management program handles crew placement, insurance coordination, maintenance scheduling, and compliance — so you can simply enjoy ownership.

Learn more

Cleaning & Detailing

Professional boat cleaning and detailing that restores your vessel to showroom condition. Waxing, hull cleaning, interior detailing, and protective coatings applied by specialists.

Learn more

Electronics & Systems

Installation and servicing of marine electronics — chartplotters, radar, AIS, autopilot, stereo systems, and custom wiring harnesses by ABYC-certified technicians.

Learn more

Sales & Brokerage

Expert brokerage for buyers and sellers. We handle search, survey coordination, sea trials, documentation, and escrow — making the transaction seamless and transparent.

Learn more

Concierge & Charters

Docking assistance, fueling, provisioning, and charter coordination. Whether you need a captained day trip or a week-long cruise, we arrange every detail.

Learn more
Mercury · Garmin · Simrad · FLIR

Quality Part Sales

Every part your vessel deserves.

Marine Pointe stocks a curated selection of OEM and aftermarket marine parts from the world's most trusted brands. If it's not on our shelves, we'll source it — fast.

  • Engine components & outboard parts
  • Marine electronics & navigation systems
  • Rigging, hardware & deck equipment
  • Safety equipment & USCG-required gear
  • Interior fittings & upholstery materials

Your home on
